contract: A23-14 (user 2026-10-05): Lv1-9 dailies = three different short goals (king slime 3 strict / slime 12-15, skill hits 3-5, hunting gold 40-60), 72 gold + 120 XP each and a 144 + 240 chest (one day = 600 XP < 1381 for Lv10), vacation 252 + 420 per missed rookie day, chest capped to the generation band; golden goose co-op when only one of Halo/Horns is present: target 20 x headcount, 70% of the winner reward, 0 war points, 3 manual hits to be paid, Neutral excluded, GooseFinished still fired (quest credit), rival-left tug judged by the co-op rule; free class change below Lv5 keeps level/XP (no ticket spent, HP fraction kept), from Lv5 free = Lv1 / XP 0 and ticket = level kept.
limitations: Offline doubles: DataStore table, seeded Util.Random, ProgressionService pay recorder (no level-ups), faction counts from the fixture roster, no goose 3D model, rate limits always pass. Client HUD/Panels are only checked statically. Studio play, multiple clients and the real timers are not certified here.
